_comment: Per-entrant feedback for bounty 1409. Rendered to /feedback/<bounty_id>/<handle> by scripts/build-feedback-pages.py, with a shared index at /feedback/<bounty_id>. TIED TO THE BOUNTY, NOT TO A HANDLE: Zaal, 2026-09-22, 'its not a slug we can reuse so lets make sure its tied to bounty'. A handle enters more than one round, so /feedback/predaking would be overwritten by round three and the round-one notes would silently vanish. SHARED ON PURPOSE: same ruling, 'so they can see what feedback others got too'. This overrides the unlisted design and research doc 2536 decision 3; the ranking guard matters MORE now, because entrants will read each other's pages side by side.

round.label: Bounty one

next.label: Round three
next.wants: Anything except a poster. Video, audio, a meme, a comic, something physical you put up in a real place. Make the thing only you would make.
next.checkpoint: Tag a draft by 12pm Eastern and you get one specific note back before 2pm. Final claim by 5pm. If two entries land in the same place, the one that took a note wins.

decided_it: Every fact a person needs was ON the piece, not only in the caption.
It was built on the real kit rather than a lookalike.
It was submitted as the actual file, not a screenshot of a post.

entrants.headline: Everything is on it. Design for the crop next time.
entrants.did_well: You went and got the running order and what each act plays, and you credited attabotty and Candy without being asked.

items.title: Design for the crop
items.body: It is 9:16, and a feed crops that from the centre. Your bottom band went first and zaostock.com went with it. Anything that has to survive being seen belongs out of the bottom fifth.

items.title: It is a programme, not an invitation
items.body: Everything a person needs is on it, which is why it scored where it did. What it does not have is a reason to come. One line of why beats one more fact.

entrants.headline: The art clears the bar. The handover did not.
entrants.did_well: The artwork carries every fact on its own. Date, year, noon to six, free, eight acts, Franklin Street Parklet, Ellsworth Maine, on the real moose.

items.title: Upload the file, not a screenshot of your post
items.body: What we are holding is a photo of a phone screen with the app chrome and the battery icon in it. The artwork clears the bar on its own; only the handover did not.

items.title: Pick one and stand behind it
items.body: You sent several because you were not sure which was wanted, which is a good instinct. Next time send the one you would defend, and say why in the claim.

entrants.headline: Striking, and not usable as it stands.
entrants.did_well: The composition pulls the eye straight down the page and lands on the moose, and you turned it around fast.

items.title: The band photos are people who do not exist
items.body: The Crown Vics, OPEN X, Grass Rug and Acadia Rising are real people who will be standing on that street. We cannot put another face under their name. Their names set in the kit type would have made this runnable.

items.title: No date and no place on it
items.body: Somebody can see this and still not know when to turn up or where. Those two facts are the difference between striking and usable.

items.title: The moose is redrawn
items.body: The mark in the kit is the one on the site, the posters and the shirts. A different moose, even a good one, reads as a different festival.

entrants.headline: The right idea, arriving late and silent.
entrants.did_well: You shot it on a real street with real flyers. Eleven entries in across two rounds and you are still the only person who has made something physical.

items.title: Every fact is in the caption and none on screen
items.body: Three seconds holding ZAOstock, Saturday October 3, Ellsworth Maine would have fixed it. A clip gets reposted without its caption and then it says nothing.

items.title: It landed after the close
items.body: 59 minutes past 4pm, which is the only reason it could not be judged. Nothing about the piece was the problem.

items.title: You claimed a screenshot, not the video
items.body: So the thing you actually made is a click away from the bounty page instead of on it.

entrants.headline: Fact-complete, off-brand on the mark, and late.
entrants.did_well: Every fact plus all eight names, and it still holds together at square. That much type at 1:1 is genuinely hard.

items.title: The moose is redrawn
items.body: Yours is a good drawing and it is not the mark that is on the site, the posters and the shirts. Dropping the kit file in would have made this usable as it stands.

items.title: It came in after the close
items.body: Filed after 4pm, so it could not be judged. That is the whole reason, not the work.
